title: Agreement of empirical Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $n$ and $m$ be natural numbers, let $f$ be a function from the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to the signs, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $x_1,\ldots,x_m$ be sign vectors in the cube. The rational empirical Fourier coefficient computed from the labeled samples $(x_i,f(x_i))$, viewed as a real number, equals the real empirical Fourier coefficient of $f$ on these inputs.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
One sample input for each index from $1$ to $m
